feature_description: 该数据的文献处理分支 turmeric_selected_pca2，输出2维；同一目录中参考与待测共用Train拟合的变换。
label_budget: FULL_TRAIN_REFERENCE; supervised PLS uses full Train labels
license: CC BY-SA (as stated in supplied dataset description; version unspecified)
caveats: Paper classifies authentic versus adulterated; seven-class concentration recognition is a project extension.
Raw spectra region 1750-200 contains 70 triplicate-averaged spectra from 10 base batches; other sheets are not extra independent samples.
Paper says linear baseline correction and normalization without defining the normalization norm or baseline anchors.
Use endpoint-line baseline and unit L2 norm as explicit implementation assumptions, then Train mean centering via PCA; not an exact software reproduction.
Paper selected intervals 907-782, 404-396, 383-321 cm-1; retain all native grid points in these intervals, then PCA to 2 scores.
public_split_note: Beef: official Test retained, 5 Train+1 Val per class inside official Train; honey: official Acquisition6 Test, random one eligible acquisition per product for Val; others grouped approximate 5:1:2
train_accuracy: not_evaluated; train.json is reference, not leave-group-out predictions
